title: BasicallyRevolver
description: adds a fun ULTRAKILL-esque  fun to the game
body:
this mod adds a GUN to the game, it in many ways inspired by ULTRAKILL

# gun
- the gun can interrupt ender-pearls, causing it thrower to instantly teleport to it
- it can break arrow projectiles
- it can boost tridents, turning them into a raycast, that will deal 12 damage on hit, and can pierce up to 4 entities
- if you shoot a slimeball item, the shot will become bouncy, bouncing 3 times by default, +1 bounce per every item in the thrown stack
- can explode all explosive non-living entities instantly when shot
- will make bells ring when shot

use EMI or something for the skin recipes

# laser pointer
- laser pointer item, points laser, thats it
- its dyeable like armor and stuff
- it automatically points the laser when put in a glow item frame
- you can read out a signal from the block the item frame is placed on with a comparator, the signal strength is determined by how close the first collision of the laser beam was
